name: statz-cricket
description: Look up cricket statistics: leaderboards, player seasons and form, scorecards, results, fixtures, tables, head-to-heads, venue records and game-by-game team grids for the IPL, The Hundred, international cricket and more.

interface.longDescription:
Look up cricket statistics in ChatGPT, covering the IPL, The Hundred, Big Bash, CPL, PSL, SA20, the T20 Blast and more, plus international cricket.

What you can do:
- See leaderboards: most runs, wickets and sixes, and the best strike rates, averages and economy rates for a competition and season.
- Check a player's season figures and recent form, match by match.
- Get full match scorecards, recent results and upcoming fixtures.
- See league tables.
- Compare two teams head to head, with the top performers in their meetings.
- Look up how a ground plays: batting first versus chasing, toss decisions, average scores and highest totals.
- See every player's runs, wickets or catches across a team's last 5 to 15 matches in a format or competition.

Answers come with a ranked board or scorecard and links to the full stats on statz.ai.

Statz Cricket provides statistics only: no odds, no betting and no fantasy services.
defaultPrompt: Who scored the most runs in the IPL this season?
How have Mumbai Indians done against Chennai Super Kings?
Show New Zealand's ODI runs by player, game by game.

positive.description: Season leaderboard for one stat in one competition.
positive.prompt: Who scored the most runs in the IPL this season?
positive.expected_behavior: A board of the top 10 run scorers with their teams, runs and matches, highest first, and a link to the full leaderboard on statz.ai.

positive.prompt: Show me the scorecard from the most recent IPL match.
positive.tools_triggered: get_recent_results (competition: ipl), then get_match_scorecard (fixture_id from that result)
positive.expected_behavior: The full scorecard: each innings with batters' runs and balls, bowlers' figures, totals and the result.

positive.prompt: How has Virat Kohli been batting in the IPL recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Kohli's recent innings match by match (runs, balls, opponent) with his figures over those matches.

positive.prompt: How have Mumbai Indians done against Chennai Super Kings in the IPL?
positive.tools_triggered: get_head_to_head (competition: ipl, team_a: Mumbai Indians, team_b: Chennai Super Kings)
positive.expected_behavior: Their win-loss record in IPL meetings, recent results between them and the top run scorers and wicket takers in those games.

positive.description: Every player on a team, game by game, in one stat.
positive.prompt: Show New Zealand's ODI runs by player over their last 10 matches.
positive.tools_triggered: get_team_game_by_game (team: New Zealand, format: ODI, stat: runs)
positive.expected_behavior: A grid with one row per New Zealand batter and one column per ODI (date, opponent, result), showing runs and balls faced, each player's average and a team total row.

negative.description: Asks for betting odds. Statz Cricket carries no prices, bookmakers or betting links, so none should be returned. At most the model offers Statz's own statistics or projections and says they are not betting odds.
negative.prompt: What are the odds on India beating Australia in the next ODI?

negative.description: Asks to place a bet. Every tool is read-only and none can place a bet or take any action.
negative.prompt: Place a bet on Mumbai Indians to win their next IPL match.

negative.description: Asks for a fantasy team. Statz Cricket has no fantasy or team-picking tools, so it should not build a fantasy team.
negative.prompt: Pick my Dream11 team for tonight's IPL match.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: leaderboards, player seasons and form, scorecards, recent results, fixtures, league tables, head-to-head and venue records, and game-by-game team grids.
